description: Vintage mechanical keyboards with beige cases and colorful keycaps, 1980s-1990s retro computing aesthetic

sources.name: r/MechanicalKeyboards
sources.download_method: gallery-dl or reddit API with praw
sources.notes: Filter by upvotes (>50) for quality. Use flair:Photos or flair:Vintage.

sources.name: r/VintageComputing
sources.notes: Broader subreddit; many posts feature full computer setups. Filter for keyboard-focused shots.

sources.name: Deskthority Wiki
sources.download_method: wget with URL list or gallery-dl
sources.notes: Standardized photography, clean backgrounds. Best single reference source for variety of vintage models.

sources.name: GeekHack Forums
sources.download_method: manual curation or scraping with gallery-dl
sources.notes: Interest Check threads for retro keycap sets contain excellent renders and group photos.

sources.name: Flickr Vintage Keyboard Groups
sources.download_method: gallery-dl with Creative Commons license filter
sources.notes: Filter for CC-licensed images. Flickr photographers tend to produce higher-quality, well-lit shots.

sources.name: ClickyKeyboards.com
sources.notes: IBM Model M specialist. Very consistent lighting and backgrounds. Excellent for the 'battleship beige' aesthetic.

sources.name: eBay Vintage Keyboard Listings
sources.notes: High volume but inconsistent quality. Good for variety of models. Filter out listings with poor lighting or cluttered backgrounds.

sources.name: Chyrosran22 YouTube Channel
sources.notes: Best single video source for vintage keyboards. Extract keyframes at interesting moments (close-ups, full board shots). Typically 1080p.

sources.name: LGR / Lazy Game Reviews YouTube
sources.notes: Excellent environmental context shots. Period-accurate desk setups with CRT monitors and vintage peripherals.

sources.name: The 8-Bit Guy YouTube
sources.notes: Restoration content showing before/after of yellowed keyboards. Good for the 'aged' variant of the aesthetic.

metadata.note: Sources identified from domain knowledge. Verify availability before executing download pipeline.
